newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends flat on high dlr supply.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends flat on high dlr supply.

text.p: The Sri Lanka closed little changed against the dollar on Wednesday amid high dollar supply, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.93 against the dollar after opening at 58.92.
"The market was thin, and there were enough dollars to supply the little demand," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
The central bank pushed the dollar up by 4.25 local cents, fixing buying and selling rates at 58.9149 and 60.1051.
Overnight call money was at nine percent, with the market well offered. The central bank's overnight repo was at 8.5 percent.
